commitments.detail: Replace module M-17 to remove the AGPL-licensed library before external release, and record the license review result in the launch packet.

Insert into the contract draft the requirement to provide a SOC 2 Type II report before production use and an annual customer audit right in the definitive agreement, consistent with the anchor hospital's letter of intent.
